name: aso-appstore-screenshots
title_zh: 读懂代码库，自动生成高转化率的 App Store
tagline_zh: 不用再对着空白画布发愁。它从你的代码里挖出核心卖点，直接产出 ASO 优化的截图，连 Nano Banana Pr。
tagline_en: Stop staring at a blank canvas. It mines your codebase for core benefits and outputs ASO-tuned screenshots with.
desc_en: Generate high-converting App Store screenshots by analyzing your app's codebase, discovering core benefits, and creating ASO-optimized screenshot images using Nano Banana Pro.
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是真正解析代码结构，把功能点翻译成用户能感知的利益点，再交给图像模型生成——从逻辑到视觉。
why_en: No templates—it parses your actual code, translates features into user-facing benefits, then hands off to the image model.
limit_zh: 只认 iOS 原生工程（Xcode 项目），Flutter/RN 项目需先导出原生壳。生成的截图是 6.7 英寸尺寸。
limit_en: iOS native projects only (Xcode); Flutter/RN need a native shell first. Output is 6.7" size only—other devices need manual resizing. No ASO ranking.
